dreamteamer.title: Companies
dreamteamer.description: An organisation — `companies`, the one record every module points at when it names one: a contact's employer, a meeting's counterpart, a project's client, a product's customer. Holds the name, what the company does, its website, domain, LinkedIn page and logo, and parent/subsidiary links. With `contacts` installed, each company also lists its people. Logos are `assets` records.
